name: Code Translation (Cross-Language)
description: Code translated from one language to another — target_code must pass the same logical tests as source_code, must implement the same function (not a substitute), the declared source_language must match what source_code actually parses as, and the tests must assert on values (not merely a type).
executionEnv: polyglot sandbox (python3 / node / tsx / javac+java / go / rustc / gcc+g++ / ruby / php / mono)

fields.label: Shared logical tests
fields.help: target_code must pass these, written in target_language.
